title: Seasons
label: ch:hi-seasons
canDo: I can name all six traditional Indian seasons in Hindi, including the one the four-season frame has no word for.

payoff.summary: Say all six ऋतु in order and point to वर्षा, the monsoon season no Western four-season label maps onto.
payoff.note: Left at 3/7, below the floor, because no honest repair exists without reordering lessons. HI-C14-ritu now also recalls ghī from HI-C14-ghee (sequence 609, path HI-PATH-100), which is earlier on both orders. The candrabindu and घ segments (HI-S118, HI-S136, sequence 611-612) come later by sequence. HI-S125-letter-vocalic-r (613) writes ऋ out of ऋतु and is the chapter's last lesson by sequence, but it sits in HI-PATH-016, before ऋतु's HI-PATH-017 on the curriculum path. So it cannot take ऋतु's season atoms, and a payoff without them would not test the chapter's can-do (name all six seasons). That move was tried and fails curriculum-prerequisite-order. The repair needs the sequence and the path to agree for this chapter.
